title: Surgical therapy for reduction of metbolic dysfunction
summary: In the ChARMeD study, a detailed characterization of the metabolism will be performed in severely obese people before and after bariatric surgery. The aim of this study is to investigate the benefits of bariatric procedures for obese people with and without diseases such as fatty liver or type 2 diabetes.
conditions: obesity, diabetes mellitus type 2, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease

interventions.name:
Patients with obesity grade II and grade III with/without type 2 diabetes mellitus before and after bariatric surgery.
Examinations will be performed before bariatric surgery and after surgery (after 4 weeks, 6 months, 12 months and 24 months).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age ≥ 20 and ≤ 70 years, BMI 35-39.9 kg/m² (obesity grade II), > 40kg/m² (obesity grade III), capacity to consent, presence of informed consent as per consent form
Exclusion criteria:
Acute infections (CRP > 5 mg/dl, body temperature > 37.5 °C), autoimmune diseases and immunocompromising diseases, renal insufficiency (creatinine > 1.5 mg/dl), severe chronic diseases, anemia (Hb < 12g/l for males, Hb < 11g/l for females, control on each examination day), participation in another intervention study within 2 months prior to the examination, intake of immunomodulatory medications (e.g. oral cortisone preparations, biologicals), medication with antithrombotic drugs, thyroid disease with unstable metabolic status (change in L-thyroxine dose within the last 6 weeks, TSH and fT4 outside the normal range), pregnancy, lactation period, previous/current alcohol and/or drug abuse, HIV, hepatitis B or C disease, liver disease not attributed to the presence of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, night shift work or circumstances that do not allow a normal day-night rhythm, blood clotting or wound healing disorders or positive history of venous thrombosis, hypersensitivity to local aesthetics, malignant tumor disease or tumor treatment within the last 5 years (with the exception of malignant skin diseases that were treated curatively), contraindications for an MRI examination (metallic implants, claustrophobia, etc.) (relative exclusion criterion).
